ACE_STOCK.title: Card Stock
ACE_STOCK.description: Playing colored cards adds their colors to your Stock. Stock can be [gold]Consumed[/gold] by effects or [gold]Flipped[/gold] to trigger powerful effects based on the colors and amount of Stock available.
ACE_FLIP.title: Flip
ACE_FLIP.description: Consume [gold]Stocks[/gold] and apply effects based on the color of the [gold]Stocks[/gold] consumed. Flip effects become stronger the more [gold]Stocks[/gold] of the same colour are Flipped.
ACE_UNSTOCKABLE.title: Unstockable
ACE_UNSTOCKABLE.description: This card has a color but does not add its color to your [gold]Stock[/gold] when played.
ACE_MAJORITY.title: Majority
ACE_MAJORITY.description: The color that appears most often in your Stock. If multiple colors are tied, the oldest tied color becomes the Majority.
ACE_CONSUME.title: Consume
ACE_CONSUME.description: Spend [gold]Stocks[/gold] to activate effects. Consumed [gold]Stocks[/gold] do NOT apply their [gold]Flip[/gold] effects.
ACE_RED.title: Red Flip Effects:
ACE_RED.description:
Level 1 - Deal 8 damage.
Level 2 - Deal 12 damage.
Level 3 - Deal 16 damage to ALL enemies.
Level 4 - Deal 25 damage to ALL enemies.
Level 5 - Deal 40 damage to ALL enemies.
ACE_YELLOW.title: Yellow Flip Effects:
ACE_YELLOW.description:
Level 1 - Draw 2 cards.
Level 2 - Draw 2 cards and gain 1 Energy.
Level 3 - Draw 2 cards. Your next 2 Skills cost 0 this turn.
Level 4 - Draw 2 cards. All Skills in your hand cost 0 this turn.
Level 5 - Draw 2 cards. All cards in your hand cost 0 this turn.
ACE_BLUE.title: Blue Flip Effects:
ACE_BLUE.description:
Level 1 - Gain 10 Block.
Level 2 - Gain 16 Block.
Level 3 - Gain 8 Plating.
Level 4 - Gain 2 Buffer.
Level 5 - Gain 1 Intangible.
ACE_WHITE.title: White Flip Effects:
ACE_WHITE.description:
Level 1 - Apply 2 Weak and Vulnerable to an enemy.
Level 2 - Apply 2 Breaksight to an enemy.
Level 3 - Apply 2 Breaksight to ALL enemies.
Level 4 - Apply 3 Breaksight to ALL enemies.
Level 5 - Stun all enemies.

Breaksight reduces damage dealt by 75% and increases damage taken by 75%.
